title: Protein Language Models, Human NAMs and Evidence Fusion for Allergenicity and Immunotoxicity Risk Assessment of Novel Food Proteins.
journal: Food and chemical toxicology : an international journal published for the British Industrial Biological Research Association
one_liner_zh: 该综述整合蛋白语言模型、结构预测与人类NAMs，提出新型食品蛋白致敏性与免疫毒性风险评估框架，虽以蛋白结构计算为辅助工具，但核心是风险评估而非结构建模方法创新，对蛋白结构计算课题有间接启发。
abstract: Novel food proteins from precision fermentation, edible insects, cell-cultured systems, microbial biomass and protein engineering are expanding faster than traditional toxicology workflows can evaluate them. Their principal safety question is not classical systemic toxicity alone, but whether sequence novelty, post-translational modification, processing, digestion, food-matrix exposure and immune recognition combine to create IgE-mediated allergenicity, coeliac-relevant peptides or broader immunotoxic concern. This review develops a next-generation risk assessment framework in which protein language models, structure prediction, digestomics, immunopeptidomics, human intestinal and immune new approach methodologies (NAMs), exposure modelling and physiologically based kinetic reasoning are integrated into a transparent weight-of-evidence process. The review is deliberately positioned beyond single-tool allergen prediction: it argues that sequence similarity, AI classification and in vitro digestibility become useful for regulatory decision-making only when anchored to an adverse outcome pathway, human-relevant assays, exposure context, uncertainty analysis and external validation. The central conclusion is that AI-enabled NAMs can transform novel protein assessment from a binary hazard screen into a mechanistically interpretable, exposure-aware and decision-oriented system, but only if datasets, benchmark design, applicability domains and reporting standards are improved. An author-proposed scoring rule and a retrospective EFSA yellow-mealworm case illustrate the workflow.
abstract_zh: 来自精密发酵、食用昆虫、细胞培养系统、微生物生物质和蛋白质工程的新型食品蛋白质，其发展速度超过了传统毒理学工作流程的评估能力。它们的主要安全问题不仅限于经典的系统性毒性，还在于序列新颖性、翻译后修饰、加工、消化、食品基质暴露和免疫识别是否共同作用，产生IgE介导的过敏原性、乳糜泻相关肽或更广泛的免疫毒性担忧。本综述开发了一个下一代风险评估框架，其中蛋白质语言模型、结构预测、消化组学、免疫肽组学、人类肠道和免疫新方法方法（NAMs）、暴露建模和基于生理学的动力学推理被整合到一个透明的证据权重过程中。本综述明确超越单一工具过敏原预测：它主张，序列相似性、AI分类和体外消化性只有在锚定到不良结局通路、人类相关检测、暴露背景、不确定性分析和外部验证时，才对监管决策有用。核心结论是，AI驱动的NAMs可以将新型蛋白质评估从二元危害筛查转变为机制可解释、暴露感知和决策导向的系统，但前提是数据集、基准设计、适用域和报告标准得到改进。作者提出的评分规则和回顾性EFSA黄粉虫案例说明了该工作流程。
